how to build libiconv


on a x86_64 system, do
    mkdir -p ~/REPO
    cd ~
    export MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.4
	wget https://mirror.init7.net/gnu/libiconv/libiconv-1.19.tar.gz
	tar xvzf libiconv-1.19.tar.gz 
	cd libiconv-1.19
	CC=clang CXX=clang++ MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.4 ./configure --enable-static
	CC=clang CXX=clang++ MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.4 make -j20
	sudo CC=clang CXX=clang++ MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.4 make install
	sudo CC=clang CXX=clang++ MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.4 make DESTDIR=~/REPO/libiconv-1.19-x86_64 install
	

then go to ~/REPO

    cd ~/REPO
    tar -cvzf libiconv-x86_64.tar.gz libiconv-x86_64

copy the file to your arm64 system and untar it in ~/REPO/

    cd ~/REPO
    sudo tar -xvzf  libiconv-x86_64.tar.gz
    

Now build the arm64 version

    cd ~
    export MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.4
	wget https://mirror.init7.net/gnu/libiconv/libiconv-1.19.tar.gz
	tar xvzf libiconv-1.19.tar.gz 
	cd libiconv-1.19
	CC=clang CXX=clang++ MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.4 ./configure --enable-static
	CC=clang CXX=clang++ MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.4 make -j20
	sudo CC=clang CXX=clang++ MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.4 make install
	sudo CC=clang CXX=clang++ MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.4 make DESTDIR=~/REPO/libiconv-1.19-arm64 install
	sudo CC=clang CXX=clang++ MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.4 make DESTDIR=~/REPO/libiconv-1.19 install

 
 Now merge the files
 
    cd ~/REPO/libiconv/usr/local/lib/
    
    for X in libiconv.2.dylib libcharset.1.dylib
    do
        sudo lipo -arch x86_64 ~/REPO/libiconv-x86_64/usr/local/lib/${X}  \
                  -arch arm64 ~/REPO/libiconv-arm64/usr/local/lib/${X} \
                  -create -output ~/REPO/libiconv/usr/local/lib/${X}
    done

Now add a pkgconfig file manually

	mkdir -p ~/REPO/libiconv-1.19/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
	F=~/REPO/libiconv-1.19/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/libiconv.pc 
	echo '# pkg-config source file' > $F
	echo 'prefix=/usr/local' >> $F
	echo 'exec_prefix=${prefix}' >> $F
	echo 'libdir=${exec_prefix}/lib' >> $F
	echo 'includedir=${prefix}/include' >> $F
	echo '' >> $F
	echo 'Cflags: -I${includedir}' >> $F
	echo 'Libs: -L${libdir} -liconv' >> $F
	echo '' >> $F
	echo 'Name: libiconv' >> $F
	echo 'Description: libiconv' >> $F
	echo 'Version: 1.19.0' >> $F

Now build a package

    cd ~/REPO/
    pkgbuild --root libiconv-1.19  --ownership recommended --install-location / --version "1.19" --identifier <identifier>  "libiconv-1.19.pkg"
    codesign -s <signature>  libiconv-1.19.0.pkg
